cards.name: 401J
cards.text: Add a Truss Trust, a Grubbing Goblin and a Soul Shard to your GY.

cards.name: A Duel of Wits
cards.text: Answer one true statement about your own deck. Correct: +4 Cards. Wrong or timed out: nothing.

options.label: My deck's average cost is above (3)
My deck's average cost is (3) or less
My deck holds more than 16 unique cards
My deck holds 16 or fewer unique cards

cards.name: A Fool's Prayer
cards.text: 10% chance of +20 Money.
cards.flavor: Somebody has to be the tenth.

cards.name: A Gaze into the Past
cards.text: +1 Action. Add a random Legacy card from the Entire Universe to your hand.

cards.name: A Glimpse of the Past
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. Add a random Legacy card from the Entire Universe to your hand.

cards.name: AA's Bargain
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Card, +3 Money, -2 VP.

cards.name: Accel Giant
cards.text: On buy, every other card in this pile costs (2) less. +2 Actions, +2 Buys, +2 Cards.
cards.flavor: The first one is always the most expensive.

cards.name: Advanced Refining
cards.text: Trash a Resource in your hand and add its upgrade to your hand.
cards.flavor: Copper to Silver to Gold to Diamond. No further.

cards.name: Aggressive Taxation
cards.text: The Money from the next Resource each opponent plays is paid to you at the start of your next turn instead.
cards.flavor: Compliance is not optional and never was.

cards.name: Alien Dropshipping
cards.text: Play on Buy, Flimsy. Shuffle 3 random (6)-cost Entire Universe cards into your Library with Flimsy.

cards.name: All In
cards.text: Play on Buy, Flimsy. Recruit your entire deck, then trash it.

cards.name: All Night Baby
cards.text: Trash a card in your hand for +1 Action. If it was a Felinor, +3 Actions instead.
cards.flavor: Three in the morning and it wants to play.

cards.name: Ambush Bid
cards.text: +1 Action. Reveal your top card and a random opponent’s. If yours costs more, +2 Money and draw it. Otherwise discard both.

cards.name: Ancient Acquisition
cards.text: Discover a card in your GY and add it to your hand, then repeat (excluding Ancient Acquisition). +1 Action.

effects.prompt: Discover a card in your GY

then.prompt: Discover another card in your GY

cards.name: Ancient Curse
cards.text: -7 VP. Shuffle a copy of this curse into an opponent’s deck. That copy does not spread further.
cards.flavor: It only needed one host to start.

cards.name: Ancient Curse Echo
cards.text: -7 VP.

cards.name: Another Round?
cards.text: The top 2 cards of your Library get +1 Card and +1 Money until end of turn. +1 Card, +1 Money.

cards.name: Antibody Extraction
cards.text: +1 Action. Put a Plague Token on a random card in your hand, then trash up to 2 plagued cards from your hand for +1 Card and +1 Money each.
cards.flavor: The cure is in the patient.

cards.name: Antics
cards.text: Recruit an Action from an opponent’s Library into your hand. At end of turn it returns to their GY.

cards.name: Arc of the Universe
cards.text: +1 Action. Align with the Center of the Universe: 90% +3 VP, 9% +25 VP, 1% +999 VP.

branches.displayAs: The Center of the Universe. +999 VP.

cards.name: Archivist
cards.text: +1 Action. Choose one: add a Temporary Book to your hand; or remove Temporary from every Book in your hand.
cards.flavor: Some things are meant to be kept.

options.label: Add a Temporary Book to your hand
Remove Temporary from all Books in your hand

cards.name: Archwarden of Jlore
cards.text: Flimsy. Lock the Jlore pile until (8) worth of cards have been discarded. +1 Action, +1 Card.
cards.flavor: The vault opens when the tribute is paid.

cards.name: Arm of the Jempire
cards.text: Lock 3 random piles until your next turn. +1 Card for each of them you could have afforded. +1 Action.

cards.name: Around the World
cards.text: Combo 5: +5 Cards.

cards.name: Ascendant Spread
cards.text: When you gain this, it secretly becomes worth 1 or 2 VP. Only you know which.
cards.flavor: Read the cards. Do not show the cards.

branches.displayAs: Ascendant Spread is worth 1 or 2 VP.
Ascendant Spread is worth 1 or 2 VP.

cards.name: Astrologist
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. On every even-numbered Astrologist trashed this game, add a Lunar Fragment to your hand. ({astrologistsTrashed} trashed.)

cards.name: Aura Farming
cards.text: Add 2 Flimsy Warhero Tokens to your GY.

cards.name: Aura Gambit
cards.text: +1 Action. Give each opponent a Flimsy Warhero Token. When one of those Tokens is trashed, it goes to your GY instead.
cards.flavor: A gift with a return address.

cards.name: Baby Witch
cards.text: Add a Cursed Pig to each opponent’s GY.
cards.flavor: She is learning. You are the homework.

cards.name: Back From the GY
cards.text: Choose: 4 GY Actions costing (0)-(2), 2 costing (3)-(4), or 1 costing (5)-(7). Add them to your hand. +3 Actions.

options.label: 4 GY Actions costing (0)-(2)
2 GY Actions costing (3)-(4)
1 GY Action costing (5)-(7)

cards.name: Back to Basics
cards.text: Flimsy. Lock every pile costing (6) or more until the end of your next turn. +1 Action.

cards.name: Back to the Raq
cards.text: Trash 2 random cards in your Library to drop 2 Books into your GY.

cards.name: Bad Omen
cards.text: Flimsy. Choose a pile: buying from it now also gives the buyer a Cursed Pig.
cards.flavor: Something is wrong with that shelf.

cards.name: Bag of Relics
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. Add 3 Relics to your hand.
cards.flavor: Rummage. Something in there is already powerful.

cards.name: Balanced Rapid Draw
cards.text: +4 Cards, then discard 4 cards. +1 Action.

cards.name: Banana
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. Discover a Known Universe card costing (1) or less.

effects.prompt: Discover a card costing (1) or less

cards.name: Better Budder
cards.text: +1 Action. Turn every Food in your hand into Gold, and every Gold in your GY into Food.
cards.flavor: It is better. It is budder.

cards.name: Biblical Greed
cards.text: Flimsy. Lose all your Money. In 5 turns, +X Money and +3 Buys, where X is four times the Money lost plus 5.
cards.flavor: Seven lean turns, then the fat one.

cards.name: Big Egg
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. Then randomly one of +2 Money, +2 Buys, +2 Cards or +2 Actions.

cards.name: Big Grape
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action, +1 Card. Play every Action in your hand, in random order.

cards.name: Big Spenda
cards.text: +2 Buys, +2 Cards, +2 Money.

cards.name: Big Time Racketeer
cards.text: +1 Card. Repeat until you draw a card costing (2) or less.
cards.flavor: He only wants the good stuff.

cards.name: Big Truss
cards.text: Big Action 2. +3 Actions, +4 Cards.

cards.name: Biology Project
cards.text: Add a Diamond from the pile to every player’s hand.
cards.flavor: Group project. Everyone gets the grade.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.text: Lock a Draft Shop pile until the end of your next turn. +1 Action, +1 Card.
cards.flavor: The lights go out over one aisle.

cards.name: Blood Diamond
cards.text: +5 Money, -5 VP.
cards.flavor: Somebody paid for this. Not you.

cards.name: Blood Diamond Cutter
cards.text: Trash Actions costing (1) or less from your hand to reduce this card’s cost by (2) each. +1 Action, +5 Money.
cards.flavor: A steady hand and a cheap conscience.

cards.name: Blubber Baron
cards.text: Add up to 2 shop cards costing (2) or less to your GY.

cards.name: Blueberry Pie
cards.text: Flimsy. Add 3 random Rare Actions from your Known Universe to your hand.
cards.flavor: Three slices, one for each of you.

cards.name: Boba
cards.text: Flimsy. +3 Actions, −2 Money. Add a Felinor to your hand.

cards.name: Book of Blood
cards.text: +1 Action. Give 3 Action cards in opponents’ decks Flimsy.

cards.name: Book of Books
cards.text: +1 Action. Add two Books to your hand.

cards.name: Book of Conspiracy
cards.text: +1 Action, +3 Prophet.
cards.flavor: It was them. It was always them.

cards.name: Book of Curses
cards.text: +1 Action. Add 3 Cursed Pigs to each opponent’s GY.
cards.flavor: Pigs, specifically. The author was very clear.

cards.name: Book of Felinors
cards.text: +1 Action. Each player discards 2 cards at random and gains 2 Felinors in hand.
cards.flavor: They got into the shelf again.

cards.name: Book of Flame
cards.text: +1 Action. Trash a card in your hand for +5 Money.
cards.flavor: Burns brighter for what it eats.

cards.name: Book of Frost
cards.text: +1 Action. Each opponent discards down to 1 card.

cards.name: Book of Greed
cards.text: +1 Action. Add 3 random Shop cards to your hand.

cards.name: Book of Knowledge
cards.text: +1 Action, +5 Cards.
cards.flavor: Read it once and you will never need to again.

cards.name: Book of Lethal Kill
cards.text: +1 Action. If your deck’s total cost is divisible by 13, +13 Money and +13 Buys.

cards.name: Book of Moon
cards.text: +1 Action. Add a Lunar Fragment to your hand.

cards.name: Book of Random
cards.text: +1 Action. Add 1–5 random cards from the Entire Universe to your hand.

cards.name: BOOM! Big Max
cards.text: When discarded, gain a Plague Token. ({plague} so far.) Active only at 5+ tokens: add a Jlore to your GY, +3 VP, +1 Action, +1 Card.
cards.flavor: It has been ticking for a while now.

cards.name: Boots on the Ground
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Card. Repeat this if it was the first card you played this turn.

cards.name: Box of Kitties
cards.text: +1 Action. Add 2 Felinors to your hand. If you trash a Felinor this turn, +1 Buy.
cards.flavor: Free to a good home. Any home. Please.

cards.name: Bribe
cards.text: Flimsy. Discover a card in an opponent’s hand and take it. Give that opponent a Diamond.
cards.flavor: Everyone left satisfied. One of them was wrong.

effects.prompt: Discover a card in an opponent’s hand to take.

cards.name: Brownie
cards.text: Flimsy — loses Flimsy while it sits on the edge of your hand. +1 Action, +2 Cards.

cards.name: Buffer Overflow
cards.text: +4 Cards, then discard 2 at random. +1 Money for each Resource discarded this way.

cards.name: Bulk Eggs
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. Add 24 random Eggs to your hand.
cards.flavor: You will need a bigger hand.

cards.name: Bullseye
cards.text: +1 VP. When you discard this: trash every card in your hand costing (1) or less, and Nerf one card in each opponent’s hand per card trashed.

cards.name: Call to Chaos
cards.flavor: Thirty-one ways for this to go.

cards.name: Carat
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Money, +1 VP.
cards.flavor: A carrot, weighed as a gem.

cards.name: Card Destruction
cards.text: Discard up to X cards, then draw X cards. +1 Action.
cards.flavor: Out with the old, in with the same.

cards.name: Card Mastery
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action. The next Action you play gains Play on Draw (random targets).

cards.name: Card Sleeve
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action, +1 Card. Remove Flimsy and Temporary from every card in your deck.

cards.name: Careful Investment
cards.text: +2 Money at the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Chains of the Sovereign
cards.text: Play on Buy, Flimsy. Lock a Draft Shop pile. Unlocking it costs an opponent (-2) Prophet. Fails if half or more of the Draft piles are already Locked.

cards.name: Chicken Coop
cards.text: +1 Action. Add 3 random Eggs to your hand.
cards.flavor: It keeps producing. That is the whole idea.

cards.name: Chonker
cards.text: Big Action 2. +4 Cards. When this is trashed, add a Food to your hand.
cards.flavor: He is not fat. He is load-bearing.

cards.name: Chopped Chuzz
cards.text: -1 VP. When this attempts to Fuse, it is trashed instead. When trashed, +3 Actions.
cards.flavor: It does not fuse. It scatters.

cards.name: Chron Break
cards.text: Cast on Draw, Flimsy. End your turn. Then take another one.

cards.name: Chron Caché
cards.text: Replace the second card of a random pile with a Diamond costing (0). +1 Action.

cards.name: Chron Job
cards.text: +1 Action, +2 Money. After playing, put this 6th from the top of your Library.

cards.name: Clipped Wings
cards.text: +1 Action. Until your next turn, an opponent who gains a card costing (6) or more also gains a Cursed Pig.
cards.flavor: Fly lower. It is safer down here.

cards.name: Cloud Nine
cards.text: Remove all cost changes and Locks from the Shop. +1 Action, +1 Buy, +1 Card.

cards.name: CN Auspicious Kitty
cards.text: +1 Action. Add a Felinor to your hand with either +2 Money or +2 VP.
cards.flavor: The paw waves. The fortune follows.

options.label: A Felinor with +2 Money
A Felinor with +2 VP

cards.name: CN Backed War Bonds
cards.text: Play on Buy. Flimsy. +1 Buy. Add 5 Grubbing Goblins and a War! to your GY.

cards.name: CN Century of Humiliation
cards.text: +1 Action. Replace every card in your hand with a card costing (1) more, then Nerf them.

cards.name: CN Century of Prosperity
cards.text: +8 Money, +1 Action. Add a random CN card to every player’s hand.

cards.name: CN Developer
cards.text: Add an Upcycle to your GY. When discarded at end of turn, add two Upcycles to your GY instead.
cards.flavor: Ship it, then ship it again.

cards.name: CN-phobia
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action, +3 Money, +1 Card. Trash a CN card in an opponent’s deck; if you do, +2 Money.

cards.name: CN Succulent Xiao
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action, +1 Buy, +1 Card.

cards.name: CN Tech
cards.text: +1 Action. Add a Shop card costing (5) or less to your hand.
cards.flavor: Same specs, half the price, none of the warranty.

cards.name: CNcias
cards.text: +1 Action. Discover a Known Universe card costing (2) or less that is not in this match. Add it to your hand with a Plague Token.

effects.prompt: Discover a card costing (2) or less that is not in this match

cards.name: Coal
cards.text: -1 Money. On the 3rd play, trash this and add a Diamond to your hand. ({playsLeft} left!)
cards.flavor: Pressure, time, and two bad turns.

cards.name: Combo Meal
cards.text: Flimsy. +2 Actions. Combo 2: +1 Action.
cards.flavor: Would you like to make that a combo?

cards.name: Conjure Aura
cards.text: Flimsy. Manifest a Celestial Aura.

cards.name: Conjure Rosemary Triscuits
cards.text: Add 2 Rosemary Triscuits to your hand.

cards.name: Constellation
cards.text: End of Game: +1 VP for every 2 unique cards in your deck. ({uniqueCardsInDeck} unique.)

cards.name: Controlled Burn
cards.text: Trash your GY. +2 Cards, +1 Action.

cards.name: Cookie Gruzzler
cards.text: Trash the top card of each player’s Library. When this card is trashed, add all of them to your GY. ({gruzzled} stored)

cards.name: Cookie Guild
cards.text: Recruit an Action costing (3) or less.

cards.name: Copper
cards.text: +1 Money.

cards.name: Cornucopia
cards.text: At end of turn, if you used no Buys, shuffle 10 random Foods into your Library.
cards.flavor: It refills while you are looking at it.

cards.name: Coronation
cards.text: +4 VP, +4 Actions, +4 Buys, +4 Cards, +4 Money. Shuffle a Rebellion into an opponent’s deck.
cards.flavor: Every crown ships with its own uprising.

cards.name: Corpo Espionage
cards.text: +1 Action. Reveal the top card of each opponent’s Library, then add a Temporary copy of one of them to your hand.

cards.name: Corrosion
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Card. Give Flimsy to 3 cards in opponents’ decks.
cards.flavor: It spreads where it is wettest.

cards.name: Corruption Scandal
cards.text: Flimsy. Take an opponent’s entire hand. Give that opponent 5 Diamonds.

cards.name: Cost Co.
cards.text: +2 Actions, +2 Buys, +2 Cards, +2 Money.

cards.name: Counter Spell
cards.text: +1 Action. The next Action each opponent plays is discarded instead of resolving. They do not lose the Action.

cards.name: Counting Cards
cards.text: Reveal cards from the top of your Library, adding their costs; (1)-cost cards count as 11 or 1. Stop at 17 or more. At 21 or under, play them all; if you bust, discard them all.
cards.flavor: The house is your own Library.

cards.name: Courtyard of Squeam
cards.text: +X VP, where X is floor(4 - the average cost of your deck).

cards.name: Craft a Card
cards.text: Flimsy. Costs the most of (1), (5) and (10) you can afford. Craft a card from two menus and add it to your GY. Paid ({craftPrice}): X and Y scale 1/1, 3/2, 6/3.

cards.name: Crime Wave
cards.text: +2 Actions. Combo 3: return this to your hand. Then reset your Combo.

cards.name: Crop Dusting
cards.text: Put 1 Plague Token on the top card of every Shop pile. +2 Money if any of them had none.
cards.flavor: Low pass over the whole market.

cards.name: Crumb
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Action, +1 Card, +1 Money.
cards.flavor: The best part of the cookie, arguably.

cards.name: Cult Leader
cards.text: Add a Draft Shop card you can currently afford to your GY. If that emptied the pile, steal every copy of it from your opponents.
cards.flavor: He takes the last one, then all the others.

cards.name: Cult Recruiter
cards.text: You may buy from only one pile this turn. +2 Buys, +2 Money.

cards.name: Cup Runneth Over
cards.text: Flimsy. Fully replenish a Draft pile. Its cards now cost (1) less, to a minimum of (1).

cards.name: Currency Cremator
cards.text: Trash a Resource card from your hand for +3 Money.

cards.name: Cursed Pig
cards.text: -1 VP.
cards.flavor: It followed you home. It is staying.

cards.name: Day Trader
cards.text: +2 Money, repeated for each Silver in your GY.

cards.name: Daylight Salesman

cards.name: Trash for Treasure
cards.text: Trash a card in your hand, then Discover a Draft Shop card costing (3) or less and add it to your hand.

cards.name: Treasure Vault
cards.text: +X VP, where X is 3 plus the number of Diamonds in your deck.

cards.name: Truss
cards.text: +2 Actions, +1 Card.

cards.name: Truss Flick
cards.text: Flimsy. Trash a Truss for +3 Cards and +6 Actions.
cards.flavor: One flick and the whole frame comes down.

cards.name: Truss Monk
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Card. Add a Truss to your GY.
cards.flavor: He builds one a day and says nothing about it.

cards.name: Truss Pluss
cards.text: +4 Actions, +2 Cards.

cards.name: Truss Trust
cards.text: Flimsy. Add 2 Tix and 2 Truss to your GY.

cards.name: 25th Hour
cards.text: After your 25th turn, immediately take an extra turn. One extra turn per copy. (Turn {currentTurn}.)

cards.name: Twisting Nether
cards.text: Flimsy. Choose a shop pile other than Jlore and trash it entirely.
cards.flavor: It was there. Now it is not.

cards.name: Two Mans
cards.text: +1 Action. Trash another card in your hand. If it was a Felinor, draw your most expensive card. Otherwise add a Felinor to your hand.
cards.flavor: Two of them. Always exactly two.

cards.name: Tylannt
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Card. Add a Warhero Token to the top of your Library.
cards.flavor: He promotes from within. Always himself.

cards.name: Ultimate Infestation
cards.text: +5 Actions, +5 Buys, +5 Cards, +5 Money.

cards.name: Uncle Musabi
cards.text: Flimsy. +1 Card. Transform every card costing (2) or less in your Library into a Grubbing Goblin.
cards.flavor: He knows what they were. He does not care.

cards.name: Universal Buff!
cards.text: Flimsy. Choose a Draft pile. Randomly Buff every copy of that card, wherever it is.

cards.name: Universal Nerf!
cards.text: Flimsy. Choose a Draft pile. Randomly Nerf every copy of that card, wherever it is.

cards.name: Upcycle
cards.text: Trash a card in your hand to gain a card costing up to (2) more than it.

cards.name: Upcycled Upcycle
cards.text: Trash a card in your hand to gain a card costing up to (3) more than it.

cards.name: Vault
cards.text: Big Action 5, Flimsy. Add two Diamonds to your hand.

cards.name: Venture Backed
cards.text: +2 Cards, +2 Money. If you gained 3 or more cards this turn, including tokens, +1 Action and +1 Buy.
cards.flavor: Growth at all costs, and the costs are all growth.

cards.name: Vexxed
cards.text: Swap the costs of two random piles.
cards.flavor: The tags got mixed up. Nobody is fixing it.

cards.name: Villa D. Moneybags
cards.text: Add a Gold to your hand and a Gold to each opponent’s GY.
cards.flavor: Generous, in a way that costs him nothing.

cards.name: Virtual Bank Robbery
cards.text: Flimsy. Add a Robux and a Tix to your GY.
cards.flavor: No vault, no guards, no witnesses.

cards.name: War!
cards.text: Every player reveals their top card and casts it in. The highest cost takes all of them. On a tie, each tied player bets 3 more cards and compares again.
cards.flavor: War. War never changes the shuffle.

cards.name: War Bonds
cards.text: Play on Buy. Flimsy. +1 Buy. Add 3 Grubbing Goblins to your GY.
cards.flavor: Sold door to door, mostly to goblins.

cards.name: Wardrum's Bold Prediction
cards.text: Flimsy. Transform your entire deck into random Known Universe cards.

cards.name: Wardrum's Mystery Box
cards.text: Flimsy. Cast 5 random Entire Universe Actions with random targets.

cards.name: Warhero Token
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Money, +1 VP.

cards.name: Water Into Swine
cards.text: Add a Cursed Pig to the top of every non-empty Draft pile.

cards.name: Weasel Turner
cards.text: Shuffle 3 copies of Weasel Turner into each opponent’s deck.
cards.flavor: It multiplies in other people’s pockets.

cards.name: Welfare
cards.text: Choose a shop card and add it to every player’s GY in turn order, starting with you. +1 Action.

cards.name: Whale Poaching
cards.text: +X VP, where X is floor(your deck size / 12).

cards.name: What is Love?
cards.text: Discover 2 Known Universe cards, Fuse them and add the result to your hand — twice. +2 Actions.

cards.name: Window Shopping
cards.text: Add a shop card costing (2) or less to your GY. +1 Buy.
cards.flavor: Looking is free. This one is too.

cards.name: Wish Upon the Stars
cards.text: +1 Action, +1 Card. On the 100th play of this card this game, summon the Hypercelestial Aura Shooting Star. ({playCount}/100)

cards.name: Wombo Combo
cards.text: +1 Action. Combo 1: permanently gain the Combo clause of a random Combo card. ({absorbedClauses} absorbed.)

cards.name: You're all fired
cards.text: Trash your hand and this card. +2 Buys, +10 Money.

cards.name: Yuya's Embrace
cards.text: Flimsy. Discover a Points card from your Known Universe and add it to your GY.
cards.flavor: She holds on until it scores.

cards.name: Zephrys
cards.text: Discover the perfect card for your hand. +1 Action.
cards.flavor: The wish is granted, more or less.

effects.prompt: Discover the perfect card for your hand

cards.name: Zzlurper
cards.text: Trash a card in the Shop. +1 Action.
